fusions.name: Held Line
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Warding Glint
fusions.desc: Flicks a glint that deals 5 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Interposed Notice
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
